children: UK mineral producer's H1 revenue fell 20% due to lower sales volumes early in period
Company posted H1 net loss after tax, impacted by non-cash share-based payment charge
Raised £8.7 mln in equity to fund Redmoor Project, increasing mineral resource estimate
Company says it is fully funded for planned activities through pre-feasibility at Redmoor
Priorities for 2026-2027 include 22,500m drilling, testwork, and resource update at Redmoor
Company cites strong tungsten prices and supply constraints as supportive for Redmoor strategy
LOWER COBRE SALES VOLUMES - Co said revenue decline was due to temporary fall in purchase volumes from largest buyer in Jan and Feb, which have since returned to average levels
SHARE-BASED PAYMENT CHARGE - Loss before tax included a non-cash share-based payment charge of $812,000 relating to options granted in Feb 2026
HIGHER OVERHEADS - Group overhead expenses increased as co expanded technical team and site facilities for Redmoor project
The one available analyst rating on the shares is "buy"
The average consensus recommendation for the iron & steel peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Strategic Minerals PLC is GBp1.90, about 63.5% below its September 24 closing price of GBp5.20
